questions.question: Tell me about yourself.
questions.student_answer: I am Deepthi, a third-year AIML student. I have experience in Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL and Machine Learning.

questions.question: Explain Object-Oriented Programming.
questions.student_answer: OOP is based on classes and objects. It consists of Encapsulation, Inheritance, Polymorphism and Abstraction.

questions.question: Difference between List and Tuple?
questions.student_answer: Lists are mutable whereas tuples are immutable. Tuples consume less memory.

questions.question: What is FastAPI?
questions.student_answer: FastAPI is a Python framework used to develop high-performance REST APIs with automatic Swagger documentation.

questions.question: Explain SQL JOINs.
questions.student_answer: INNER JOIN and LEFT JOIN are clear to me. I need more practice with RIGHT JOIN and FULL OUTER JOIN.

questions.question: Difference between GET and POST?
questions.student_answer: GET retrieves data and POST sends data to create resources.

questions.question: What is Machine Learning?
questions.student_answer: Machine Learning allows computers to learn patterns from data without explicit programming.

overall_feedback: Deepthi performed well throughout the interview. She demonstrated strong backend knowledge and communication skills. Improving SQL and DSA will increase her chances in product-based companies.
